text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Oka Sho. A grand 
Classic-class stage an Umamusume can only 
enter once in her lifetime. The stands 
were roaring with excitement...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion witnessed an Umamusume 
trembling with nerves.
And seeing her face 
the race with such earnest devotion...
she found a radiant brilliance in it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today,
whichever girl shines the brightest 
will win— Feeling the weight of this race 
once more, Fine Motion renewed her 
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Given her special background,
she draws an 
extraordinary amount of attention.
Yet she 
quiets the clamor with a graceful smile, 
stepping up to the race with a composed 
expression...!
